import numpy as np\n\
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\
\n\
# Load MSD data\n\
data = np.loadtxt('msd.txt', comments='#')\n\
timesteps = data[:, 0]\n\
msd_values = data[:, 1]\n\
\n\
# Consider data from timestep 148700 onwards\n\

timesteps = timesteps[start_index:]\n\
msd_values = msd_values[start_index:]\n\
\n\
# Calculate the slope of MSD vs time\n\
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(timesteps, msd_values, 1)\n\
\n\
# Calculate diffusion constant\n\
diffusion_constant = slope / 6\n\
\n\
# Save the result\n\
with open('diffusion_constant.txt', 'w') as f:\n\
    f.write(f'{diffusion_constant:.2e}')\n\
\n\
# Plot for verification (optional)\n\
plt.plot(timesteps, msd_values, label='MSD')\n\
plt.plot(timesteps, slope * timesteps + intercept, label='Fit', linestyle='--')\n\
plt.xlabel('Timestep')\n\
plt.ylabel('MSD')\n\
plt.legend()\n\
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png')\n\
"
